translations.translation: Brightening results confirmed in a clinical study
This product does not guarantee brightening results; individual results may vary
Helps reduce the look of fine lines
translations.note: '주름 개선' → 'helps reduce the look of fine lines' (규제 매핑 적용)

translations.translation: Helps reduce the look of fine lines — not dermatologist-informed proven
translations.note: '주름 개선' 및 '의학적' 매핑 적용. 원문은 부정 문맥(입증된 바 없음)이라 대체 표현 삽입 시 문장이 다소 어색해짐

translations.translation: Intensive care for skin lacking renewing vitality

translations.note: 브랜드/제품명은 원표기 유지하되 '미백'은 매핑 적용해 'Brightening'으로 표기

translations.translation: New launch in the age-defying line
From a dermatologist interview: "This ingredient is not for care purposes"
translations.note: '치료' → 'care' (규제 매핑 적용). 부정 문맥이라 의미가 다소 모호해짐

translations.translation: Dual function: brightening and helps reduce the look of fine lines
Fast-acting comfort for blemish-prone concerns, plus a pore-refining appearance
Supports renewing and helps for a firmer look
Made with pure naturally derived ingredients
Age-defying and age-defying care in one
translations.note: '노화 방지'와 '안티에이징' 모두 'age-defying'으로 매핑되어 중복 발생. 실제 배치 시 'Age-defying care in one step' 등 단일 표현 권장
